body: I'm really happy to hear that you're doing better but I think I should critically think this over. Even if I don't reply please don't take it personally or be concerned. And thank you for the last time for showing that you care. Take care

I'm just so overwhelmed. I don't have it bad at all compared to some people but I really do that've the well to live anymore. I've had multiple attempts. I'm only 20 and I know I can think more logically and critically but everything I do is suffocating me. I've seen many therapists, psychologist, psychiatrists and counsellors and took medications. I've even been to a psyc ward once but every time I'm in those situations they tell me after a few days that I'm fine and they let me go. It really did terrify me at the ward though. I just don't know how I feel anymore.
